data.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD2: grep for SPRINT_MODE, DSO_SPRINT_MODE, MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE in plugins/dso/scripts/ returns zero results (active code lines only)
- DD4: All tests pass after cleanup

## Implementation

Remove or replace all active (non-comment) references to the eliminated env vars DSO_SPRINT_MODE and MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE from the following files:

### 1. plugins/dso/scripts/apply-attribution-trailers.sh

Lines ~471-472:
```bash
# BEFORE:
# DSO_SPRINT_MODE=1 bypasses the attribution.enabled guard...
if [[ "$_attribution_enabled" != "true" && -z "${DSO_SPRINT_MODE:-}" ]]; then
    exit 0
fi
```

The DSO_SPRINT_MODE bypass was used during sprint mode to force trailer injection even when attribution.enabled=false. Determine the correct replacement:
- Option A: Remove the bypass entirely — after epic completion, the DSO-Story trailer is always injected when called from sprint Phase F (which is the only caller)
- Option B: Replace DSO_SPRINT_MODE with a different mechanism (e.g., a command-line flag --force-inject or reading a new config key)

Check how check-sprint-trailer.sh and sprint SKILL.md Phase F currently use DSO_SPRINT_MODE to determine which Option is correct. If Phase F sets DSO_SPRINT_MODE=1 before calling apply-attribution-trailers.sh, the replacement must preserve the behavioral bypass.

### 2. plugins/dso/scripts/check-sprint-trailer.sh

Lines 3-4, 8:
```bash
# BEFORE:
# When DSO_SPRINT_MODE=1, the latest commit must contain a DSO-Story: trailer.
# Set DSO_SPRINT_MODE=1 in the shell before committing (done by sprint SKILL.md Phase F).
if [[ -z "${DSO_SPRINT_MODE:-}" ]]; then
    exit 0
fi
```

This script is triggered as a pre-commit hook but only runs when DSO_SPRINT_MODE=1. After env var removal, determine the replacement gating mechanism:
- Option A: Read a file marker (e.g., .sprint-active sentinel that already exists)
- Option B: Read a new config key
- Option C: This script becomes unconditionally enabled (if appropriate)

Check sprint SKILL.md Phase F to see how this env var is set and what the gating should be replaced with.

### 3. plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-direct.sh

Line ~616:
```bash
# BEFORE:
if [[ "${MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE:-}" == "1" ]]; then
```

MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE was set by merge-to-main-pr.sh before calling this script. After removal, determine how merge-to-main-direct.sh should detect it's in PR mode — likely via a command-line argument or by removing this branch entirely if it's dead code.

### 4. plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh

Lines ~2165, ~2167:
```bash
# BEFORE:
export MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE=1
# ... call merge-to-main-direct.sh ...
unset MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE
```

Remove the export/unset. If merge-to-main-direct.sh needs to know it's in PR mode, use a command-line argument instead: pass `--pr-mode` to the direct script.

### Investigation First

Before making any changes:
1. Read plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md Phase F to understand how DSO_SPRINT_MODE is used
2. Read plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh ~line 2160-2170 for full context of MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE
3. Grep for any callers that SET these env vars: `grep -rn 'DSO_SPRINT_MODE=\|MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE=' plugins/dso/`

### Behavioral Preservation

The removal must preserve behavioral equivalence:
- check-sprint-trailer.sh: still only enforces trailer when in sprint mode (gate must still work)
- apply-attribution-trailers.sh: still bypasses when attribution disabled AND not in sprint mode
- merge-to-main-pr.sh/direct.sh: still correctly share behavior between direct and PR modes

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh 2>&1 | tail -5
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || true
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || true
- [ ] apply-attribution-trailers.sh has no active DSO_SPRINT_MODE reference
  Verify: { grep 'DSO_SPRINT_MODE' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/apply-attribution-trailers.sh | grep -v '^[[:space:]]*#'; test $? -ne 0; } 2>/dev/null; true
- [ ] check-sprint-trailer.sh has no active DSO_SPRINT_MODE reference
  Verify: { grep 'DSO_SPRINT_MODE' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/check-sprint-trailer.sh | grep -v '^[[:space:]]*#'; test $? -ne 0; } 2>/dev/null; true
- [ ] merge-to-main-direct.sh has no active MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE reference
  Verify: { grep 'MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-direct.sh | grep -v '^[[:space:]]*#'; test $? -ne 0; } 2>/dev/null; true
- [ ] merge-to-main-pr.sh has no active MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE reference
  Verify: { grep 'MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh | grep -v '^[[:space:]]*#'; test $? -ne 0; } 2>/dev/null; true
- [ ] Task 3 fitness function test_no_eliminated_env_vars_in_scripts now PASSES (GREEN)
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/scripts/test-no-legacy-config-key-refs.sh 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -qE 'FAILED: 0'
- [ ] Sprint trailer gate still functions: check-sprint-trailer.sh exits 0 when not in sprint mode (via replacement mechanism)
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/check-sprint-trailer.sh 2>&1; true
- [ ] Merge-to-main PR mode behavior preserved: merge-to-main-pr.sh can still invoke merge-to-main-direct.sh (smoke test with --help or --dry-run if supported)
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main.sh --help 2>&1 | grep -q 'merge\|direct\|pr' || true
